title: Hurt
syncedLyrics:
[00:12.89] I hurt myself today
[00:18.27] To see if I still feel
[00:23.45] I focus on the pain
[00:28.84] The only thing that's real
[00:34.21] The needle tears a hole
[00:39.56] The old familiar sting
[00:44.40] Try to kill it all away
[00:49.68] But I remember everything
[00:55.76] What have I become
[01:01.38] My sweetest friend
[01:06.24] Everyone I know goes away

[01:27.26] I will let you down
[01:32.51] I will make you hurt
[01:37.51]

[01:58.73] Full of broken thoughts
[02:03.98] I cannot repair
[02:09.24] Beneath the stains of time
[02:14.59] The feelings disappear
[02:19.82] You are someone else
[02:25.04] I am still right here
[02:30.88] What have I become
[02:36.45] My sweetest friend
[02:41.23] Everyone I know goes away
[02:47.73] In the end

[02:56.95] My empire of dirt

[03:07.47] I will make you hurt

plainLyrics:
I hurt myself today
To see if I still feel
I focus on the pain
The only thing that's real
The needle tears a hole
The old familiar sting
Try to kill it all away
But I remember everything

What have I become
My sweetest friend
Everyone I know goes away
In the end
And you could have it all
My empire of dirt
I will let you down
I will make you hurt

I wear this crown of thorns
Upon my liar's chair
Full of broken thoughts
I cannot repair
Beneath the stains of time
The feelings disappear
You are someone else
I am still right here

What have I become
My sweetest friend
Everyone I know goes away
In the end
And you could have it all
My empire of dirt
I will let you down
I will make you hurt

If I could start again
A million miles away
I would keep myself
I would find a way
